(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on a first layer; a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on a second layer; and a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and are aligned with the first layer and the second layer.

(Currently Amended) Claim 290: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section is a honeycomb structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290, wherein the ring includes a central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

(Currently Amended) Claim 293: The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring that is at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 294: The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is continuous.
